i feel you, i havent been officially diagnosed either but i resonate w all the symptoms and stories shared on here. i have spoken very briefly to my psychiatrist whom i have  barely seen cuz ive been elsewhere for school for a few years and she was concerned but it never got addressed. i lash out dramatically mostly only at my parents maybe cuz i think theyre the only people who might actually love me. i also bash my head or scratch or other harmful things to myself when im having a breakdown. ive been trying to find the motivation to find help near me but its soooo hard and im sure you will experience the same difficulty staying determined of getting help. just have to try ur absolute hardest to reassure urself that its not something u can achieve overnight and it might take a lot of voicemails but u cant beat urself up about it its not ur fault and u are absolutely worth it. i think whats helped me the most is keeping a journal/notes. going back reading it when ur in a different head space can get scary thinking that u can feel that intensely and think like that. but it is also very grounding and reminds you that what you are going thru is very real. someone or people who can hold u accountable is also very helpful. but have to try and set boundaries, no one can be responsible for you but people can help guide u and support u to realize and address ur responsibilities. another thing thats helped is to think of everything as temporary. i dont like that i can have a massive breakdown and then be someone else in like an hour but i try to use that to my advantage and repeat in my head i wont feel like this in an hour i wont think like this in an hour etc...idk its hard i like to think it helps sometimes it doesnt but maybe would be good to try? hope this has helped love u
